intervention: Train one 273-input tanh linear router to predict V59-minus-JP02 complete-command correctness. Inputs are canonical253PRE features,9V59 probabilities,11confidence/offset/history summaries. Both experts and action choices frozen. Route only eligible located predicted-move disagreements with positive expected gain. Zero initialization/ties choose JP02.
objective: Mean squared error on every eligible predicted-move disagreement, including both-wrong targets0. Targets+1 rescue,-1 regression,0 tie. No class balancing, current label input or DEV gradient.
selection: Four whole-game folds,24train/8held. Mean/std fit only active training queries within each fold. Pool complete-command counts over all held rows at epochs0,4,8,16,32; require no change-count loss and continuation loss <=0.5percentage points vsJP02. Choose most correct,then earlier epoch. Epoch0 exact baseline eligible. One fresh full32game refit for selected duration.
history: Exactly V74 chronological adapter, cached PRE masks, prior-turn commands and32turn resets. Training loader adds canonical augmented selected PREs; same predict-before-assimilate ordering.
evaluation: After selection and full refit, apply once to all14439 archived V74 DEV forecasts. No threshold search, repeats or DEV-derived routing. Report every category, paired groups, rescue/regression,changes/continuation,false positives,coverage and baseline/unconditional references.
limits: Router folds exclude their own updates, but frozen V59/JP02 experts previously trained on these fitting groups. Not end-to-end out-of-fold forecasts. Original DEV repeatedly exposed, teacher-forced history,missing observations,shops and ambiguous targets. Decision routing is not calibrated joint MAP.
